**Date:** 28/11/2026

## Agenda

- Recap quiz on Sessions 3-4 (10 min)
- 5.1 Good data by design: variables, CRF, data dictionary, checks, data management
- 5.2 Meet the course dataset FLUID-ICU (live R cleaning demo)
- 5.3 Describing and showing data: summaries, figures, tables
- 5.4 Describe the course dataset: Table 1 and figures
- Proposal builder 5: variables, mini-CRF, data dictionary, data management

## Timetable

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 19:30 | 10 | Recap quiz |
| 0:10 | 19:40 | 35 | **5.1 Good data by design:** variable types, CRF principles, data dictionary, validation, data management (EDC, double entry, audit trail, backups), preventing missing data, whole-class task: fix the CRF items |
| 0:45 | 20:15 | 25 | **5.2 [DS] Meet the course dataset:** the FLUID-ICU study, raw vs clean data, the data-quality problems found, **live R demo of cleaning** and the cleaning log, the five questions Q1 to Q5 introduced (each participant chooses one at the end of Session 6) |
| 1:10 | 20:40 | 15 | BREAK |

## Before this session

- Proposal Part 2 finished.
- Have a first look at the [course dataset](dataset.qmd) page: what FLUID-ICU is and its data dictionary.

## After this session (homework)

- **Your proposal:** finish the first half of Proposal Part 3 (variables table, mini-CRF, data-dictionary rows, data-management plan), with Exercise 8 on the Session 5 sheet.
- Look through the five results packs (Q1 to Q5) on the [Course dataset](dataset.qmd) page. You choose your question at the end of Session 6.
- **Optional:** Exercises 1, 3, 4 and 5 on the Session 5 sheet (classify the variables, choose the right summary, judge a bad figure, spot the problems in the raw FLUID-ICU data).
